summary: Forming an accurate theory-of-mind (ToM) is key to successful multi-agent collaboration and requires reasoning under uncertainty to capture multiple possible partner states. This is hard to do in the text representation space native to large language model (LLM) agents, which more easily describe a single partner state.
takeaways: This is hard to do in the text representation space native to large language model (LLM) agents, which more easily describe a single partner state.
To address this challenge, we introduce ToM2Vec, which learns to form abstract theories-of-mind in a rich latent space via a fixed budget of continuous reasoning tokens.
At test-time, ToM tokens are generated by each agent and act as conditioners for that agent's thoughts and actions.
